description: Take the seller's standing counter: the negotiation closes as accepted at that price. This commits the buyer to the price, so call it only when you mean to buy at it. A counter past its time, a closed negotiation, or a counter the seller can no longer allow answers with a conflict and binds nothing. Needs the negotiation id and the buyer token. Public: needs no credential.

buyer_token.description: The buyer token the first answer gave you, once. Keep it: it is the only way back into the negotiation.

handle.description: The seller's public handle, from the terms they publish.

negotiation_id.description: The negotiation id from the first answer.

name: accept_counter
